Item.Name: ADDR_1
Item.Hint: Enter the first line of address

Item.Name: ADDR_2
Item.Hint: Enter the second line of address

Item.Name: ADDR_3
Item.Hint: Enter the third line of address

Item.Name: STATE_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter the state code e.g TX : Texas

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.block_status in ( 'QUERY')
then
 return;
end if;
--
if :addresses.addr_1 is null then
 message ('Err: First line of address must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
if :addresses.city is null then
 message ('Err: City must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
if :addresses.state_code is null then
 message ('Err: State code must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
else
begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'STATE'
 and code = :addresses.state_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Invalid State Code ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then handle_error;
end;
end if;
--
if :addresses.zip is null then
 message ('Err: Zip code must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
if :addresses.country is null then
 message ('Err: Country must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :system.block_status = 'CHANGED'
 then
 copy (to_char(:addresses.address_id) , name_in ('global.addr_field'
));
 end if;
 GO_ITEM(name_in('global.next_field'));
end;

Item.Name: NOTE_TYPE
Item.Hint: Enter note type / [Listval] for a list of types

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :note_books.note_type is null then
 message ('Err: Note type must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
if :note_books.note is null then
 message ('Err: Note must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
